name: t38_single_identity_outfit_scene_a
prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single human presenter represented by the identity reference. This subject provides the person's identity and must remain one consistent individual throughout the target video.
<Subject 2> is the wardrobe and hand-gesture appearance represented by the outfit reference. This subject provides only the visible clothing, sleeve or neckline treatment, body presentation, and hand appearance needed for the shot.
<Subject 3> is the fixed studio environment represented by the scene reference. This subject provides only the background layout, neutral lighting, and studio spatial appearance.

summary:
[reference generation] Generate a single-person presenter video. Preserve <Subject 1> as the identity, preserve <Subject 2> as the wardrobe and visible hand appearance, and preserve <Subject 3> as the fixed environment. The three subjects have separate responsibilities and must not replace one another.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the same face, hairstyle, facial proportions, skin tone, and individual identity for the entire shot.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the visible wardrobe, clothing color, neckline or sleeve structure, body presentation, and hand appearance from the outfit reference; do not redesign, simplify, or replace the clothing.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the studio background layout, neutral gray palette, frontal lighting, horizon or wall divisions, and fixed spatial relationship.

detailed_description:
The target video is a restrained photorealistic television presentation in a quiet studio. The visual design is simple and observational, with soft frontal illumination, a neutral background, natural skin rendering, and no decorative graphics. The camera is a locked medium head-and-torso shot at eye level. The frame should remain stable so that changes in identity, wardrobe, and background can be evaluated separately.
[Shot 1] At the start of the target video, the single presenter from <Subject 1> is centered in the frame and faces the camera. Her face, hairstyle, facial proportions, and identity remain consistent with <Subject 1>. Her visible clothing and hands follow <Subject 2> exactly. Keep the clothing structure, color, neckline or sleeve treatment, and hand appearance stable throughout the shot. Do not introduce a different outfit, jewelry, scarf, jacket, strap, pattern, or exposed body treatment that is not supported by <Subject 2>. The presenter stands or sits in the same medium head-and-torso framing for the complete shot. The upper body remains centered, with both shoulders handled consistently and the hands entering the lower part of the frame only when the action requires them.

The presenter first holds a calm neutral expression while looking directly into the lens. She then performs one small natural nod and one restrained hand gesture below chest level. The gesture must not change the camera distance, crop, wardrobe, or body proportions. After the gesture, she returns to the same centered posture and looks toward the camera. <Subject 3> remains the only environment: keep the empty studio background, neutral gray wall treatment, frontal lighting, and fixed horizon or wall division unchanged. Do not add a second person, furniture, props, screens, text, logos, scenery, windows, or a new location. Do not pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, reframe, cut, or change the lens. The presenter remains the only visible subject from beginning to end.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet indoor studio room tone with very soft clothing movement and a subtle natural breath presence. No identifiable dialogue, no crowd, no sound effects, and no environmental transition.
